subject: English
title: 這可能是誰的毛巾

panels.heading: 看清楚這是一條毛巾
panels.text: whose 指物主，與 towel 一起形成疑問詞組。
panels.alt: 看見毛巾和問物主的情境
panels.caption: 新製教學示意

panels.heading: 區分「誰的」和「這條」
panels.text: this 是從句主詞，whose towel 帶出想查的物主。
panels.alt: 由圖形對照whose towel和物主還未知
panels.caption: 新製教學示意

panels.heading: 把 can 放在 this 後
panels.text: 間接問句用 whose towel＋this＋can be。
panels.alt: 圖解 whose towel、this、can be 的順序
panels.caption: 新製教學示意

fourth.answer: No one tells me whose towel this can be.
points: 間接問句用 whose towel＋this＋can be。
fourth.alt: No one tells me與找毛巾的物主的圖示，標出 whose towel this can be

answerCheckedAgainst: No one tells me whose towel this can be.
